activation: exact GELU, matching the author's declared graph
algebraic_invariants: readout(clean final residual)=clean logits; direct_11=node_reverse_11 up to F32 subtraction/readdition; checked under frozen oracle tolerance
backend: Burn 0.21 Flex F32 CPU; F64 host probability analysis

hypotheses: Clean prompts tend to favor later years more than matched 01 corruption.
Preselected late MLP node patches may recover part of the clean-to-corrupt gap.
Direct late-MLP readout contributions affect the greater-than distribution.
scientific_expectations.interpretation: Report every preselected condition and per-prompt variation even if a hypothesis fails; original 10000-sample aggregate and full circuit are not pass criteria.

limitations: Clean prompts are disjoint across splits; corrupted controls repeat and ten are shared across splits.
Per-prompt SD is descriptive variation, not an iid confidence interval.
Node patching does not reproduce the full published path-patched circuit.
Zero ablation removes the complete biased MLP output; this is an added control.
Full original rust-circuit execution, training, quantized GPT-2 import, and the paper's 10000-sample aggregate are not validated.

reference_provenance.activation_override: Source config gelu_new -> author graph gelu; weights unchanged

scope: Bounded activation-patching adaptation with separate direct MLP-to-readout measurements
